pdufa_rhhby_2026-10-15.description: Enspryng (satralizumab) sBLA for thyroid eye disease: FDA goal date October 15, 2026 under Priority Review, per Genentech's June 29, 2026 release.
pdufa_rhhby_2026-10-15.sentence: The sBLA is supported by SatraGO-1 and SatraGO-2. Per Genentech, in SatraGO-2 53% of patients on Enspryng achieved a proptosis response at week 24 versus 23% on placebo, meeting statistical significance; in SatraGO-1 the figures were 49% versus 31%, which did not meet statistical significance.

pdufa_rhhby_2026-12-18.description: Roche's giredestrant plus everolimus NDA (evERA) for ESR1-mutated advanced breast cancer has an FDA goal date of December 18, 2026, per Genentech.
pdufa_rhhby_2026-12-18.sentence: Genentech said on February 19, 2026 that the FDA accepted the NDA for giredestrant in combination with everolimus and is expected to make a decision on the approval by December 18, 2026. A separate NDA for giredestrant alone in early breast cancer (lidERA) has a November 30, 2026 goal date.

pdufa_rhhby_2026-11-30.description: Roche's giredestrant NDA for adjuvant early breast cancer (lidERA) has an FDA goal date of November 30, 2026, per Genentech's June 1, 2026 release.
pdufa_rhhby_2026-11-30.sentence: Genentech said on June 1, 2026 that the FDA accepted the NDA for giredestrant in early breast cancer (lidERA) and is expected to make a decision on the approval by November 30, 2026. A separate NDA for giredestrant with everolimus in advanced breast cancer (evERA) has a December 18, 2026 goal date.

pdufa_cogt_2026-12-30.description: Cogent's bezuclastinib NDA for nonadvanced systemic mastocytosis (SUMMIT) has an FDA goal date of December 30, 2026, per Cogent's August 10, 2026 8-K.
pdufa_cogt_2026-12-30.sentence: Per Cogent's August 10, 2026 8-K, the PDUFA date for bezuclastinib in nonadvanced systemic mastocytosis (the SUMMIT application) is December 30, 2026, and the PDUFA date for bezuclastinib in GIST (PEAK) is November 30, 2026.

pdufa_cogt_2026-11-30.description: Cogent's bezuclastinib application in GIST (PEAK) has an FDA goal date of November 30, 2026, per Cogent's August 10, 2026 8-K.
pdufa_cogt_2026-11-30.sentence: Per Cogent's August 10, 2026 8-K, the PDUFA date for bezuclastinib in GIST (the PEAK application) is November 30, 2026, and the PDUFA date for bezuclastinib in nonadvanced systemic mastocytosis (SUMMIT) is December 30, 2026.
